device_name: Global Cascadia Lateral 3D Sell Sheet Smacc Approved 2

fields.what_it_is: Cascadia Lateral 3D Interbody System featuring Lamellar 3D Titanium Technology. The technology incorporates 300-500 μm longitudinal channels, which in conjunction with transverse windows, create an interconnected lattice designed to allow for bony integration. Implant has 3-5 μm surface roughness to allow for direct bony ongrowth. Reverse hourglass design that allows for increased endplate contact and large graft volume space.
fields.compatible_with: Designed to work with the Ravine Lateral Access System.
fields.use_notes: Offering a full line of instrumentation for the direct lateral transpsoas approach.
